promptAssembly: prompt = common + '\n' + screen.prompt. 이미지 참조로 styleReferenceDir/styleReference를 넘긴다(alsoReference는 필요할 때만). 틀 1024×600에 가장 가까운 비율(27:16)로 뽑는다.
wording: 2026-09-24 사용자 요청으로 화면 문구를 docs/design/wording.md(문구 표)대로 바꿨다: 대화형 말(~하기 · ~드림 · ~주세요 · 약속)을 짧은 시스템 말로. 배치 · 크기는 그대로다. title · primary · mustShow와 prompt의 따옴표 안 화면 글이 모두 새 말이다. higgsfield/의 그림(results.json)은 이 문구 변경 전의 첫 설명서로 뽑은 것이라 그림 속 글은 옛 말이고, 다시 뽑지 않았다(크레딧 0). 다시 뽑을 일이 생기면 지금의 prompt를 쓴다.
common: High-fidelity UI mockup of ONE screen of 스키노트, the touch-screen POS web app of a Korean ski rental shop, drawn flat and straight-on and filling the whole canvas edge to edge: no device bezel, no browser chrome, no hands, no perspective, no annotations, no extra screens. Match the IMPLEMENTED app shown in the attached screenshot exactly. Visual system: a warm beige desk background #E9E3D6; cream paper sheets #FFFDF7 with a 4px radius and a soft navy shadow; navy ink text #1B2A4A, secondary #34425F, muted gray-blue #56627A; thin ruled lines #C9D3E0 between rows and faint column rules #E3E8EF; page and slip titles in a Korean Myeongjo-like serif at 24px with a 2px navy rule under the title row; everything else in the Pretendard sans-serif, bold 700 to 900. The header is 60px high directly on the beige desk (no colored band, no logo wordmark): at the left a navy filled button with a small book icon and cream text "장부", then gray bold "우리 스키샵"; at the right cream outlined buttons 52px tall with a 2px navy border and a 10px radius: "끝 4자리" with a small keypad icon, "수거 목록", "리프트권", "확인 필요", a bell icon button with a small navy round badge "2", "관리", and "나가기" with an exit icon. There is NO left sidebar and NO vertical menu rail anywhere. Paper index tabs stand on the title rule: the active tab is cream, outlined in 2px navy and joined to the paper; inactive tabs are beige #F6F0E3 with gray text and a light border. Progress is shown with ink stamps: a step not done yet is an empty dashed gray-navy circle about 48px; a finished step is a vermilion #CC3D14 ink ring (3px) on a pale vermilion wash #FCEFEA with the Korean word and time inside (for example 지급 / 16:05), slightly rotated like a real hand stamp; a partly done step has an orange #E8540F ring; a step the delivery van will do is a light-purple rounded box with purple text (for example 차량 / 22:00); a step another team will pay is a light-blue rounded box "예정". The vermilion stamp color is NOT a warning. Crimson #B01030 appears ONLY on late things (text plus a 3px left bar), never elsewhere. Selected choice buttons are filled navy with cream text; unselected buttons are cream with a 2px navy border and navy bold text. On POS screens there is exactly ONE primary button, solid orange #E8540F with heavy white 20px text, 56px tall, 10px radius; everything else is outlined. On driver screens the single primary is solid purple #5F33E1, 72px tall. Dialogs are cream cards 860px wide with a 10px radius over a 45% navy scrim; the dialog title row is 56px with heavy 24px navy text and a 2px navy rule under it; the dialog bottom row is 72px with an outlined button showing a left chevron and "닫기" at the left and the orange primary at the right. Frame exactly 1024×600 px. Text is at least 16px everywhere (body 17px, titles 24px, key amounts 20–28px bold), every touch target is at least 52px tall (56px on driver screens), no ellipsis, no clipped text, no half-cut rows, no scrollbars; long lists are paged with "‹ 1 / 2쪽 ›". All UI text is Korean, crisp and spelled EXACTLY as written in quotes below; no English words anywhere, no lorem ipsum, no watermark. Money is written with commas and 원 (120,000원); phone numbers are 010-0000-xxxx.
